name: Yunus Alapan
title: Assistant Professor of Mechanical Engineering

fitReason: Recent Assistant Professor and computational soft-robot co-design backup. A full neural design method with explicit supervisory contribution is verified; actual fabricated soft robots do not establish an online learned control policy.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full March 2025 study couples MAP-Elites search with a six-hidden-layer neural surrogate and CPPN morphology encoding. Simulated candidates guide shape/magnetization design, after which fabricated magnetic soft robots jump and traverse under predefined external fields. The learned component optimizes the design offline; field-control learning is explicitly a future extension. Alapan contributed study design, analysis and supervision. This Max Planck-centered collaboration is not evidence of current UW-owned learned-control apparatus, so physical score is 0 despite real material/robot experiments.
